The '''Uthor system''' was located in the [[Agarix sector/Legends|Agarix sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creature]] known as [[Uthori breix]].<ref name="Creatures" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Uthor [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
